default.heading: Fewer missed sales. Less repeat work.
default.body: Get my emails on following up more leads, taking repeat work off your team and choosing software worth paying for. Lessons from building my own businesses, for owners building theirs.

AI decisions.heading: Find the work AI can take off your team.
AI decisions.body: Get my emails on spotting repeat work, choosing what to automate and checking whether it saves time or money. I share what I’m learning as I build my own businesses.

Software decisions.heading: Before you spend months building the wrong thing.
Software decisions.body: Get my emails on when to build, when to buy and when the software you already have is enough. Drawing on years of building software with business owners and the companies I’m building now.

Customer follow-up.heading: Win more of the sales you’re already chasing.
Customer follow-up.body: Get my emails on finding unanswered enquiries, following up quotes and keeping deals moving without doing it all yourself. Lessons from building software with business owners and running my own companies.

Building businesses.heading: Build a business that depends less on you.
Building businesses.body: Get my emails on handing off repeat work, choosing where to spend your time and deciding what to build next. I share the decisions and mistakes behind my own companies.
